title: Đề luyện Nói VSTEP — Recall RV0821 (Part 2 + 3)

questions.content:
speaking — Part 2

Situation: Your school has asked you to organise a festival for students, and you must decide what kind of festival it will be. You are considering the following options: 1. A music festival with live performances 2. A food festival where students cook and sell dishes 3. A handicraft festival where students make and display crafts Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: Choosing a new job is an important decision, and people weigh up several things before they accept an offer. Talk about the main things a person should consider when choosing a new job and which one matters most. Ideas: - The salary and benefits - The working environment - The chance to develop and be promoted - Your own idea Further questions: 1. Is a high salary more important than enjoying the work? Why? 2. How can someone find out what a company is really like before accepting a job? 3. Should young people change jobs often or stay with one employer for a long time?
